verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Pylon serves an llms.txt at docs.usepylon.com (HTTP 200) that indexes markdown pages. Every docs page is also available as a .md mirror, and a plain-JSON OpenAPI spec is published that agents can consume. missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt or first-party guidance on agent use of the docs; the root docs .md path returns a not-found page.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.usepylon.com/llms.txt # Pylon
The GitBook docs render every endpoint page from this spec URL and embed the per-endpoint OpenAPI JSON in their markdown mirrors.
